pwsbuilder June 4, 2018

Master Artist Paul Hammersten will be at The Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists on Saturday, June 9 from 10 AM to 4 PM to share the story of The Cheyenne, his masterwork created over a period of many years with his mentor Northern Cheyenne Frederick Dale Seminole. The art work hangs in the American Indian Museum at The Crazy Horse Memorial. Throughout the day, Paul will illustrate how he uses tools to create his unique leather art work. Copies of his book, When the Spirit Falls: My Storyof the Cheyenne will be available to peruse.

The Art Gallery (source page unavailable) is located at 551 Main Street (Rte.28) in Harwich Port, (508) 432-1012. Free parking across the street at the Harwich Chamber of Commerce Visitors Information Center.
